name: Hakudaku Ryuu Majo
source:
The girl known by her pseudonym "Dragon Witch" is summoned as a heroic spirit to fight in the great battle. But a miserable fate and agonizing defeat await her. Unable to escape this world, she is tormented, but nonetheless, she still holds on to... her "Pride"...



[Edited from DLsite English]
translation:
被化名“龙之魔女”的女孩作为英灵召唤出来，参加一场伟大战斗。然而，悲惨的命运与痛苦的失败正在等待她。她无法逃离这个世界，只能遭受折磨，却依然紧紧守护着……自己的“骄傲”……

[编辑自DLsite英文版]
